registry_reuse.reason: Do NOT reuse seating.go:presentCount(q *QuorumResult) in synthesize: different layers — the helper counts q.Reviewers on a built *QuorumResult while synthesize runs on []*ReviewerOutcome before any result exists, and its outcomes loop already checks VerdictReject, so the retained inline externalPresentCount increment rides in the same pass; reuse would be circular or a second pass (design doc V16).

Existing deterministic in-process stubs: fakeRunner (table-driven, absent-by-default for unlisted models) and present() cover every quorum_test.go matrix row; the seated regression reuses seating_test.go's poolRunner (records calls, for 'fallback attempted') and seat(); the Tier-2 regressions call SynthesizeWithTier2 directly with a hand-built *Tier2Result (RunQuorumWithEscalation would not escalate an all-absent Tier-1). No new runner, no credentials, no provider calls.

features.description: Change synthesize so the zero-signal guard counts present EXTERNAL reviewer outcomes only (rename to externalPresentCount; remove the controller increment; retain the guard and its exact objection text 'no reviewer produced a verdict (all absent) — refusing to proceed on zero signal'; no early return before the guard; Tier-2 stays monotonic; accounting/absence records unchanged), add the deterministic controller/signal matrix in internal/mission/quorum/quorum_test.go, the all-absent seated regression with controller pass in seating_test.go, and the Tier-2 zero-signal regression plus positive control in tier2_test.go — with the pre-fix red run of the new controller-only tests and the pre/post full-suite green pair as bounding controls, and mutation drill MU1 recorded.
acceptance_criteria: Entire matrix above passes, and new controller-only tests fail before the fix. The full package suite (`go test ./internal/mission/quorum`) run BEFORE the fix stays green immediately AFTER the fix — that pre/post pair is the bounding control for any fixture the V10/V15 textual surveys could miss (oc-glm-5.3 round-2 concern, applied verbatim).
Seated replacement remains functional and all absences remain named.
Controller/reviewer/Tier-2 rejects retain vetoes; partial-present pass stays allowed.
Existing serialization, accounting and escalation tests pass.
`go test ./internal/mission/quorum` and `go test -race ./internal/mission/quorum` pass; run repository-required checks from the approved sprint.
Contract comments and implementation report describe the intentional controller-only behavior change.

For the absent-pair/controller-pass row, assert both model/reason pairs retained in input order, controller verdict/note retained, and totals equal the supplied costs and input/output token sums (including absent outcomes).

For the two-absent/controller-reject row, assert BOTH objections in deterministic order — controller note first, then the zero-signal objection — which holds by construction: `synthesize` has no early return before the external-count guard (V13).
Assert `AbsentReviewers` remains a non-nil empty slice for all-present inputs through the existing serialization test.

Add a seated orchestration regression with primary `a`, reserve `b`, benched `z`, all absent, controller pass. Assert `blocked`, all three absences named, and fallback attempted; this catches an incorrect early-return fix that bypasses replacement or synthesizes before final outcomes.

Add Tier-2 regression using all-absent Tier-1, controller pass, and a present passing Tier-2 outcome. Assert `blocked` and zero-signal objection retained. Add a positive control with one Tier-1 pass plus one absent and Tier-2 pass: `proceed`. Existing Tier-2 reject tests preserve veto behavior.

Mutation evidence required during execution: restoring only the controller count increment must make the new controller-pass/all-absent and empty-slice/pass cases fail. Restoring the fixed source must return those tests to green. Record actual commands/results in the implementation report.
